summary: Accepted. The sealed candidate makes exactly fourteen date-only repairs to two retrospective passages. The December AD 917 memorial says only that Liu Xun's loss of discipline had already occurred; the April AD 918 use of 初 says only that Dou Mengzheng's Qian Liu edict and resulting demotion were earlier. The candidate retains the Chinese wording and evidence while replacing each fabricated 917 lower endpoint with the corresponding one-sided upper bound.

sourceEvidence.reason: In the December section of Zhenming 3 (AD 917), 自…以來 states that Liu Xun's loss of discipline preceded the memorial. It does not state when it began, so AD 915 is not a source-supported lower bound.

reviewedChanges.reason: The three claims preserve their subject, predicate, Chinese sourceDate, certainty, evidence, and non-date values while replacing only the invented AD 915–917 interval with on-or-before AD 917. The paired hint states the same one-sided chronology.
